messages:
Ava (CEO): quick follow-up from today's all-hands focused on competitive positioning. i'll be here for 15 mins to take short Qs. please keep them practical for GTM + eng.
Sam (Sales): customers ask: what's the shortest response to 'Why Redwood vs self-hosted open-source + cloud?'
Maya (Head of Strategy): short: 'We remove the operational risk and ongoing engineering burden of serving LLMs at scale 14 you get predictable latency, cost controls, and enterprise controls without rebuilding infra.' emphasize measurable outcomes.
Dev (Eng): technical nuance Q: can we promise SDK parity and identical API semantics across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private at GA?
Chris (VP Product): commit to API parity for core flows (generate/chat/embeddings). SDK ergonomics will converge but some platform-only features (billing, org admin) differ.
Sam (Sales): competitor push: "BigCloud has cheaper instances" what's the two-line rebuttal?
Ava (CEO): 'Maybe cheaper per-hour, but we win on delivered unit economics through batching, caching, and deployment patterns. plus we productize safe rollouts and observability so teams don't have to hire an ops org.'
Dev (Eng): are we going to publish a public compatibility matrix for community quant formats and runtimes?
Chris (VP Product): yes docs will include a compatibility table, perf caveats, and recommended quant profiles. that'll live on the docs site and be updated monthly.
Maya (Head of Strategy): add for GTM: sales should always surface a short customer example where rollout controls prevented a bad production regression. concrete stories beat features.
Sam (Sales): good point, do we have a sanitized example we can use in pitch decks?
Ava (CEO): yes, i'll work with customer success to produce a redacted case study this quarter. we'll include metrics (p99 improvement, cost delta).
SyncBot: note: all-hands notes uploaded to docs at 1766367950 by SyncBot
Dev (Eng): last practical q: are we advertising 'automatic fallback routing' as GA claim?
Chris (VP Product): advertise fallback policy primitives and canary rollouts as GA; automated cross-region failover is coming later. be explicit in collateral about what is automatic vs opt-in.
Ava (CEO): thanks all 14 i'll post the short GTM lines and the compatibility promise to the marketing folder. if anyone wants to expand the competitor brief, book time with maya/chris.
